title: Check if Two Chessboard Squares Have the Same Color
summary: Given two coordinates on an 8x8 chessboard, determine if the squares they represent are the same color.
statement: Given two coordinates on an 8x8 chessboard, determine if the squares they represent are the same color. Return true if they are, and false if they are not.
constraints: Coordinates name chessboard squares from a1 through h8.
Square colors alternate across every rank and file.
Return whether the two squares have the same color.
hints: Assign files and ranks zero-based numeric coordinates.
A square color is determined by the parity of file+rank.
Compare this parity for both coordinates.
Moving one square flips parity and color, so equal parity is exactly equal color.
editorial: Moving one square flips parity and color, so equal parity is exactly equal color.

tests.explanation: Both coordinate sums have even parity, so the squares share a color.
The coordinate parities differ, so the colors differ.
